verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair axis for a payments platform, but the evidence pack never documents an Adyen CLI. The only command-line artifact is the MCP server launched via `npx -y @adyen/mcp` with flags. That is a local MCP server for LLM clients, not a general-purpose CLI, so it is not credited here. The llms.txt, docs mirror and OpenAPI materials are also not CLIs.
